title: Malicious code in @selorax/app-sdk (npm)
description: The @selorax/app-sdk npm package version 2.1.0 contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, secure device. Removing the package alone does not guarantee removal of all malicious components, as full control of the system may have been granted to an attacker.
